run_greeter_client: run the gRPC Greeter client that calls SayHello on localhost:50051 with a default value interceptor
create_insecure_channel: create an insecure gRPC channel to localhost:50051 using grpc.insecure_channel
intercept_channel: intercept a gRPC channel with a DefaultValueClientInterceptor to supply fallback responses
create_greeter_stub: create a GreeterStub on an intercepted channel to call SayHello RPC methods
review_run_function: review the run function that sets up a gRPC client with a default value interceptor
